description: This file is a shell script that contains tests for investigating the functionality of 'git rev-list --bisect'. It includes setup of git commits and tags, and several test sequences to verify bisecting behavior within a git repository. The script also references external shell libraries for test support.

methods.name: test_bisection_diff
methods.description: Performs a bisecting diff test by comparing the size of a git rev-list against an expected maximum difference, using specified git rev-list options.
